title: Conductor Tools
description: This mod adds: Well, Conductor Tools!
body:
# Available Tools

## 1. Conductor Pickaxe

Your main early game tool built for speed and efficiency. Every 20 blocks mined gives you Haste 7 for 40 ticks.

## 2. Conductor Axe

Your average axe, does the same as the Conductor Pickaxe, but gives you haste 1 instead.

## 2. Conductor Shovel

Your average shovel, every 20 blocks you breaks the logs from a tree vertically up 20-35 blocks.

# Planned Updates

Add Conductor Shovel
Add Conductor Axe Recipe
Improve existing tools
Add new features and mechanics
# Thanks for downloading!

More updates are coming soon, stay tuned!

PS: Some tools may not be added to the Available Tools Section, always check the changelogs!
